name: NGOWF World Heavyweight Championship
caption: Won by 'Dangerous' Doug Milne over Joel Gutman in the finals of the fed's own inaugural tournament.
epitaph: NGOWF World Heavyweight Championship of NGOWF: the surviving 1997 Usenet record shows the reigns listed here and nothing of how the belt ended.

name: NGOWF World Tag Team Championship
caption: Awarded to Damage Control by forfeit after tournament finalist Mikey Dobson of Little & Large was jumped backstage.

name: NGOWF Television Championship
caption: Won by Lucien Champion in a twenty-man battle royal; retained once by disqualification against Bradley Fine.
